notes: Passage-checked roster from Ganguli, Mahābhārata Sabha Parva §§XXXIII–XXXVI; exact section and printed page locators are in each claim.

The central §XXXIII passage names around forty people individually as arriving at Yudhiṣṭhira’s Rājasūya. §§XXXIV–XXXVI add named role-holders and figures explicitly described as present. The material does not support 150 distinct individuals without counting anonymous collectives, regional labels, or unnamed sons.

Regional polities, group designations (for example, “all Kaurava brothers”, the Mleccha tribes, the kings of Vanga/Kalinga, and unnamed sons), and uncertain person/place forms (“Akastha”, “Kuntala”) are excluded. Salya’s repeated mention is represented once.

Vāsudeva (king of the Pauṇḍrayas) is separate from Vasudeva named as Kṛṣṇa’s father and from Kṛṣṇa/Vāsudeva. Yajñasena and Drupada are retained separately because these passages do not explicitly equate the names. Rāma is kept at Ganguli’s shorter wording.
